description: Ministry of Skills Development Employment & Labour Relations - Award made to the Industrial Disputes between M. M. K. Marikkar, 36/4D, Kithsiri Gardens, Perera Place Dehiwala and other Part Sri Lanka Ports Authority No. 19 Chaithiya Road Colombo 01
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of an arbitration award related to an industrial dispute under The Industrial Disputes Act. It involves legal proceedings, a court judgment, and the application of labor legislation, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, land, commercial, or other specialized category.
